shortDescription: AIIMS NORCET 11th Nursing Officer Admit Card 2026 is available for download. Stage-I exam is scheduled for 12 September 2026.
content:
AIIMS has issued the NORCET-11 Admit Card 2026 for the Nursing Officer recruitment examination. Candidates who successfully submitted the application form can download the hall ticket from the official portal.

The Stage-I exam is scheduled for 12 September 2026, followed by Stage-II on 30 September 2026 as per the announcement.

Important Dates

  • Application begin: 24/07/2026
  • Last date to apply: 13/08/2026
  • Exam city released: 03/09/2026
  • Admit card available: 09/09/2026
  • Stage-I exam date: 12/09/2026
  • Stage-II exam date: 30/09/2026

Application Fee

  • General / OBC: ₹3000
  • SC / ST / EWS: ₹2400
  • PH: ₹0

Fee can be paid online, and disabled candidates are exempted as per AIIMS rules.

Eligibility

Candidates must hold the required nursing qualification and valid registration with the state or nursing council, as specified in the NORCET-11 notice.

How to Download

  1. Visit the official AIIMS exam portal.
  2. Open the NORCET-11 admit card link.
  3. Login using the registered ID and password.
  4. Download the hall ticket and print it.
  5. Carry the admit card along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Read the official AIIMS portal and notice for the exact shift, centre and document instructions before the exam.
